findings.issue: The sku and warehouse arguments of fetch() are interpolated directly into the SQL string with an f-string, so a value containing a quote can change the query. fetch_many() passes its skus straight through to this path. Callers are outside this file, so reachability from request input is for the integration pass to confirm.
findings.suggested_fix: cursor.execute("SELECT qty FROM stock WHERE sku = %s AND warehouse = %s", (sku, warehouse))  # use the placeholder style of the DB driver (%s for psycopg, ? for sqlite3)
